enrollToken.description: Server-issued enrollment token from the QR provisioning bundle. It enrolls up to the number of devices it was minted for (one by default) until it expires or an admin stops it; the server answers error.agent.token.used once it enrolls no more.

enrollAttempt.description: Optional (protocol 1.6). A random id the agent generates for this enrollment and keeps until it has stored its credentials, sent again on every retry. A retry whose response was lost gets the same device back with a new secret, before that device's first check-in and within 24 h; servers that predate it ignore it.

device.description: Same as capability-matrix device, MINUS id (the server issues id on enroll).
